validation_selection.notes: Validation uses all seven compression rows through 42.75 GPa. As agreed with the user, assume the Figure 3 caption's approximate 42 GPa upper limit includes the tabulated 42.75 GPa B1 point. This is an explicit rounded-endpoint interpretation, not confirmation of the authors' exact row mask or weights. Rows at and above 44 GPa remain excluded because of the cubic-rhombohedral transition.

recalculation.notes: Row-wise NaCl lattice parameters and printed errors are bundled, along with original P_NaCl pressures. Exact Brown B1 and Fei B2 standards are not both present in the shared executable material catalog. No substitute calibration or recalculated pressures are used.

pressure_calibration.notes: The row nacl_phase is inferred from its lattice branch: a>4 A is B1, a<4 A is B2. Table S1 has B1 at 29.30 GPa, so a universal 26 GPa cutoff would mislabel observations.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.
qualifications: Independent unweighted pressure-residual validation, not Fei's published regression or a new source-owned EOS. K0-prime is fixed at 4; HS V0 is held at the reported reference value as a validation choice. LS V0 and K0 are fitted. Exact source weights and row masks are unavailable. Printed zero/missing errors are not exact weights. Compression and decompression remain separate. Published coefficients are retained even where this validation disagrees.

scientific_validation.note: Checked primary Zotero PDF visually on pages 2-3, full article text, and all three user-supplied official auxiliary tables. Published coefficients are preserved; independently computed validation never replaces them.

primary_source_check.finding: Five compression BM3 parameterizations with K0-prime=4: fp20 HS/LS, fp39 HS/LS, and mw58 HS B1 only. No separately fitted decompression EOS or mw58 rhombohedral/LS EOS is published.

primary_data_check.finding: Complete primary lattice/pressure table is bundled. Cubic B1 volumes are derived as a^3. Compression-only interval selection is explicitly a validation approximation; row weights and the exact published regression mask are unavailable. Decompression is retained only as independent observational context. For mw58, validation assumes the caption's approximate 42 GPa limit includes the tabulated 42.75 GPa B1 row; all seven points below the 44 GPa structural transition enter.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Figures 1-3 captions; paragraphs 6-15; Tables S1-S3.
parameter_provenance.equation: Paragraphs 12 and 14 identify third-order Birch-Murnaghan; captions of Figures 1-3 give K0-prime=4. This is algebraically BM2, stored as the source-named BM3 only; no duplicate BM2 entry.
parameter_provenance.V0: Figure 3: 79.36 A^3 per conventional B1 cell (Z=4). Figure 3 reference volume; no uncertainty printed.
parameter_provenance.K0: Figure 3: 153 GPa. No uncertainty printed for mw58.
parameter_provenance.fit_relationship: Original Fei compression fits, not the later Solomatova MINUTI refit. HS V0 is reported as measured; only K0-prime is explicitly registered fixed. No source covariance or exact weighting protocol is supplied.
parameter_provenance.temperature: Figures 1-3 explicitly identify 300 K. Laser annealing near 1600 K is preparation, not the EOS measurement temperature.
parameter_provenance.pressure_range: Figure 3 caption: up to 42 GPa. Interpreted, by explicit user-approved assumption, to include the 42.75 GPa Table S3 B1 observation; the structural transition is reported near 44 GPa.
